pilot_metadata.pilot_name: SignBridge AI First External Validation Pilot
pilot_metadata.target_cohort: Accredited ISL Interpreters & Deaf Master Signers
pilot_metadata.zero_fabrication_declaration: No signs in this package are synthetically fabricated. All 5 candidate signs are extracted from authentic master recordings published by the Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre (ISLRTC) under the Government Open Data License - India (GODL-India). Current linguistic verification status is PARTIALLY_VERIFIED pending external multi-center review.

signs.subject: Data Structures & Algorithms
signs.definition: A step-by-step procedure, finite sequence of rigorous instructions, typically used to solve a specific class of problems or perform a computation.

source_provenance.institution: Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre (ISLRTC)
source_provenance.governing_body: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India

mocap_metadata.tracker: MediaPipe Holistic / Vision Lite (Pose 33, Hands 21x2, Face 468)
mocap_metadata.handshape: Open-B handshape with progressive sequential tapping
mocap_metadata.movement_type: Sequential planar step translation (left to right)

known_limitations: Slight smoothing latency in ring and pinky finger distal interphalangeal (DIP) joints during rapid step transitions.
Facial non-manual marker mouthing is neutral in avatar, whereas original signer displays subtle lip rounding for 'step'.
signs.reviewer_instructions: Observe the step-wise hand movement in the synchronized video. Verify whether the 3D avatar's finger articulation and left-to-right progression preserve the semantic concept of a 'sequential step procedure' in standard ISL without requiring English captions.

signs.subject: Signals & Systems / Communication Systems
signs.definition: The rate at which a vibration occurs that constitutes a wave, either in a material or in an electromagnetic field, measured in hertz (cycles per second).

source_provenance.institution: Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre (ISLRTC)
source_provenance.governing_body: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India

mocap_metadata.handshape: Index finger extended (1-handshape) undulating in sinusoidal wave

known_limitations: Avatar wrist pitch angle during high-frequency cresting exhibits minor angular stiffness compared to human wrist fluidity.
Speed variation: Original signer accelerates toward end of stroke to indicate rapid frequency.
signs.reviewer_instructions: Evaluate whether the avatar's oscillatory wave motion accurately distinguishes electrical wave frequency from general repetitive motion or vibration.

signs.subject: Circuit Theory & Power Systems
signs.definition: The rate of flow of electric charge past a point or region in an electric circuit, measured in amperes.

source_provenance.institution: Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre (ISLRTC)
source_provenance.governing_body: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India

mocap_metadata.handshape: Bent-V / Claw handshape moving forward along conducting path
mocap_metadata.movement_type: Linear directional forward flow along forearm conduit

known_limitations: Dual-hand coordination: Base hand acts as stationary wire/conduit; avatar base hand tracking shows minimal drift.
Potential polysemic confusion with temporal 'current' (present time) if isolated without technical context.
signs.reviewer_instructions: Inspect whether the sign clearly denotes electrical current (electron flow) and avoids ambiguity with temporal 'now/current time'.

signs.subject: Structural Analysis & Mechanics of Solids
signs.definition: A structural element that primarily resists loads applied laterally to the beam's axis, creating bending moments and shear stresses.

source_provenance.institution: Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre (ISLRTC)
source_provenance.governing_body: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India

mocap_metadata.handshape: Flat horizontal Open-B palm resting across vertical support columns
mocap_metadata.movement_type: Horizontal positioning followed by downward load indication

known_limitations: Spatial orientation: Avatar palm downward flat plane must remain strictly parallel to floor; minor tilt observed at frame 42.
Sign distinguishes civil structural beam from light/laser beam; verify structural classifier correctness.
signs.reviewer_instructions: Verify whether the two-handed structural support classifier accurately represents a horizontal load-bearing beam in civil engineering ISL.

signs.subject: Theory of Machines & Applied Mechanics
signs.definition: The rotational equivalent of linear force; a measure of the force that can cause an object to rotate about an axis.

source_provenance.institution: Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre (ISLRTC)
source_provenance.governing_body: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India

mocap_metadata.handshape: C-handshape / Gripping fist rotating tangentially around axis finger

known_limitations: Twisting velocity: Rotational acceleration around the stationary axis finger is sharp; avatar wrist rotation exhibits minor damping.
Signer displays effort morpheme (puffed cheeks/tensed jaw) indicating mechanical torque resistance.
signs.reviewer_instructions: Observe the torsional twisting motion. Evaluate whether the avatar captures both the rotational direction and the physical force quality of torque.
